purpose: historical state-conditioned strategy-mixture research; no live execution

state_rules.panic: close<SMA200 and 30d drawdown<-20% and vol30>=100% annualized
state_rules.bull_core: close>SMA200 and SMA50>SMA200 and mom90>0 and vol30<120%
state_rules.bull_volatile: close>SMA200 and SMA50>SMA200 and mom90>0 and vol30>=120%

strategy_experts.bull_core: T20 intrabar pyramid stages 1x,2.5x,4x; ATR trails 3.2,1.8,1.0
strategy_experts.bull_volatile: T20 intrabar pyramid stages 1x,2x,3x; ATR trails 3.2,2.0,1.2

mixtures.long_only: bull_core pyramid + bull_volatile 1x long + trend_up 1x + recovery 0.5x + range mean-reversion + cash in bear/panic/neutral
mixtures.directional: bull_core pyramid + bull_volatile conservative pyramid + trend_up 1x + recovery 0.5x + range mean-reversion + bear -1x + panic -0.5x + cash neutral

geometry_test.causality: event time is pivot known_i; forward path begins next bar; targets already crossed at confirmation are excluded

projection: empirical 5/20/60-day return distributions conditional on current causal state; descriptive, not a forecast guarantee
